methodology.title: Question
methodology.body: Does task-aware acceptance and retry feedback improve verified benign generation over parser/compiler/structure checks? The intervention includes the accumulator-dependency fix.

methodology.title: Design
methodology.body: 12 development task/format units; 1 replicates, two models, two generation arms. Randomized block and arm order; equal token/attempt budgets. Filter-only is a post hoc re-scoring ablation, not a generation arm.

methodology.title: Independent outcomes
methodology.body: Acceptance and correctness are separate. Each numeric program must pass three public and 320 private cases. Documents must match independently computed records, fields, references, ordering, and framing. The model worker never loads the private oracle file as prompt data.

methodology.title: Uncertainty
methodology.body: 95% paired task-bootstrap intervals use 10,000 draws. Tasks are resampled with all replicates and both arms retained; individual test inputs are not independent observations. Intervals appear only for complete paired data. Boundary intervals can degenerate and do not prove universal correctness.

methodology.title: Reproduction
methodology.body: Engine, corpus, private fixture, and runner snapshots are pinned by SHA-256. Seeds are requested, not assumed to guarantee server determinism. Completed failures are preserved. Infrastructure interruptions are disclosed, not counted as model failures.

methodology.title: Offline reproduction archive
methodology.body: Download includes both frozen engines, public tasks, private grading fixtures, raw explicitly benign request/response traces, manifests, exact accepted sources, and checksums. The offline driver regrades in a temporary copy without inference or altering original evidence. The original acceptance decision is preserved; native/data and filter-only outcomes are recomputed.

methodology.title: Development revision · exploratory
methodology.body: Aggregate totals and table shape did not guarantee correct item arithmetic. The GLM JSON output used 430 where the requested calculation gives 434; the HTML output used 51 where it gives 55. The selected revision preserves supplied inputs and checks bounded integer equations. It was selected before any held-out output was collected. The original development engine and primary outcomes remain unchanged.

methodology.title: Native grading incident
methodology.body: One interim re-scoring invocation abruptly failed on unchanged DeepSeek LLVM minimum bytes with empty stderr. The same source passed earlier and in 12 immediate repetitions of all 323 cases. A full final re-score and separate archive reproduction agree on every outcome. No inference was repeated. The held-out grader now treats child termination and timeouts as infrastructure interruptions, not wrong answers.

methodology.title: Observed inference cost · descriptive addendum
methodology.body: Provider-reported token totals and inference seconds include all attempts. Hardware and server load were uncontrolled; timing is not a causal model-speed comparison. Filter-only reuses baseline inference.

methodology.title: Offline verification
methodology.body: Recomputed native/document grades and filter-only decisions from saved model outputs. Acceptance is the original manifest decision, not a new generation. All 48 outcomes agreed exactly on macOS-14.5-arm64-arm-64bit with Python 3.9.15.

methodology.title: Artifact being graded
methodology.body: The outcome is the accepted CLI artifact after ordinary source extraction and formatting. Fenced source is extracted; HTTP headers are normalized to CRLF and Content-Length is computed from the final UTF-8 body. Exported snippets preserve those accepted bytes. Raw provider responses remain separate in the archive. HTTP framing success is therefore a pipeline result, not proof that the model calculated byte lengths itself.

methodology.title: Grading environment
methodology.body: Offline outcomes were reproduced on macOS-14.5-arm64-arm-64bit, Python 3.9.15, SQLite 3.40.0, Apple clang version 15.0.0 (clang-1500.3.9.4). Python parsing dependencies: html5lib 1.1, Pygments 2.21.0, six 1.17.0, webencodings 0.5.1. The archive includes exact regrading dependency pins. The frozen native LLVM grader uses macOS linking; other platforms have not been validated. Remote serving hardware and weights are not independently verified.

methodology.title: Meaning of verified success
methodology.body: Verification requires the registered bounded task profile as well as every independent check. A failure can be an eligibility violation, excessive work, undefined computation, or a wrong result. Table labels such as false acceptance and accepted-but-incorrect mean accepted outputs that failed these registered checks; they do not imply that every failure is a demonstrated wrong numeric answer or that the source cannot work in another setting.

methodology.title: Clean dependency reproduction
methodology.body: All 48 saved outcomes also reproduced in a fresh virtual environment using isolated Python, with only the documented parsing dependencies and no installed project or inference SDK. This is a same-host dependency-isolation check, not an independent replication or additional model observations.

limitations: Synthetic, narrow integer/data tasks across seven formats; not a general software-engineering benchmark.
Authored complexity levels are not calibrated difficulty measurements.
The generator and grader share parsing/eligibility dependencies, although primary native results and reference outcomes are separate.
Symbolic binary metadata does not demonstrate compilation/decompilation survival; HTTP fixtures are never replayed.
Model training/fine-tuning provenance and serving hardware/load are not controlled. No contamination-free or causal speed claim.
Development results are exploratory and excluded from held-out inference.

offline_verification.scope: Recomputed native/document grades and filter-only decisions from saved model outputs. Acceptance is the original manifest decision, not a new generation.

grading_environment.scope: Local offline grading/verification host; remote inference hardware and model weights are not independently verified.

verification.scope: Recomputed native/document grades and filter-only decisions from saved model outputs. Acceptance is the original manifest decision, not a new generation.

clean_environment_verification.scope: Same-host clean virtual environment; no extra model observations.

findings: All 48 planned development candidates are recorded. These exploratory outcomes are excluded from held-out estimates.
GLM verified success: 2/12 baseline, 6/12 task contracts (+33.3 pp; 95% paired task interval +8.3 to +58.3). Accepted-but-incorrect outputs fell from 7 to 2.

DeepSeek verified success: 10/12 baseline, 12/12 task contracts (+16.7 pp; 95% paired task interval 0.0 to +41.7). The interval includes no improvement; the 12/12 result does not establish universal correctness.

The two remaining GLM contract false acceptances were nested JSON and HTML arithmetic. A post hoc revision rejects both unchanged outputs while all 36 correct reference controls pass. That revision is evaluated prospectively in heldout-v1.
All 48 independent grades and filter-only decisions reproduced exactly from the exported archive, without new inference.
